name: Clorox Regular Bleach
hazards: Causes severe skin burns and eye damage

firstAid.eyes: Rinse right away with plenty of water, also under the eyelids, for at least 15 minutes. Remove contact lenses if easy to do. Get medical attention right away.
firstAid.skin: Wash off right away with soap and plenty of water while removing contaminated clothes and shoes. Get medical attention right away.
firstAid.inhaled: Move the person to fresh air. Get medical attention if symptoms occur or continue.
firstAid.swallowed: Do NOT induce vomiting. Rinse mouth and drink plenty of water. Never give anything by mouth to an unconscious person. Call Poison Control or a doctor right away.

ppe: Safety glasses with side shields, or goggles
Protective (impervious) gloves
Long sleeves; chemical-resistant apron for larger amounts
Respirator only if irritation occurs or limits are exceeded
spill: Soak up with sand, earth or another non-combustible absorbent
Pick up and put in a properly labeled container
Keep the product and wash water out of drains and sewers
Dispose of according to local rules; do not reuse empty containers
storage: Keep tightly closed in a cool, dry, well-ventilated place
Store locked up, out of reach, away from other materials
mixing: SDS: incompatible with acids, bases and oxidizers
Never mix with ammonia cleaners (such as Windex Original), toilet bowl cleaners, rust removers or other cleaners: this can release toxic gas
house: Keep locked in the chemical closet. Never leave a bottle unattended in a resident area.
sourceNote: Summarized from the manufacturer SDS (Clorox Regular Bleach2, US001153). The ammonia/acid mixing line is general bleach safety guidance, not SDS text.

name: Lysol Disinfectant Spray (aerosol)
hazards: Contains gas under pressure; may explode if heated

firstAid.eyes: Flush right away with plenty of water, lifting the upper and lower eyelids, for at least 10 minutes. Get medical attention if irritation continues.
firstAid.skin: Flush skin with plenty of water. Remove contaminated clothing and shoes.
firstAid.inhaled: Move to fresh air and keep at rest in a position comfortable for breathing.
firstAid.swallowed: Rinse mouth with water. Do not induce vomiting unless medical staff tell you to.

ppe: Chemical splash goggles if spray could reach the eyes
Chemical-resistant gloves for heavy use
Use with good ventilation
spill: Remove sparks, flames and other ignition sources
Move leaking cans away from the area if safe
Keep runoff out of drains
Dispose of unused product through approved waste disposal
storage: Keep away from direct sunlight and heat; store dry, cool and ventilated
Do not puncture or burn the can, even when empty
mixing: Do not spray near open flame or any ignition source
house: Don’t spray directly near residents, especially anyone with breathing problems; spray, then ventilate the room.
sourceNote: Summarized from the Professional Lysol Disinfectant Spray – All Scents SDS (D0224478 v15.0). That SDS lists “Warning” in section 2 and “DANGER” in section 15; check your can’s label.

name: Clorox Disinfecting Wipes
hazards: Do not use or store near heat or open flame

firstAid.eyes: Hold eye open and rinse slowly and gently with water for 15–20 minutes. Remove contact lenses after the first 5 minutes, then keep rinsing. Call Poison Control or a doctor.
firstAid.skin: Wash skin with plenty of water. Get medical attention if irritation continues.
firstAid.inhaled: Move to fresh air and keep comfortable for breathing. Get medical advice if unwell.
firstAid.swallowed: Do NOT induce vomiting. If vomiting happens, keep the person leaning forward. Never give anything by mouth to an unconscious person. Call Poison Control or a doctor.

ppe: Not normally required; follow the label
Gloves and eye protection for large quantities
spill: Soak up liquid with an absorbent and rinse the surface with water
Throw used wipes in the trash; do not flush
storage: Keep tightly closed in a dry, cool, well-ventilated place
Keep out of reach of children and pets
mixing: SDS: incompatible with oxidizers and acids (e.g. bleach)
house: Residents with dementia may mistake wipes for food or tissues. Keep canisters out of resident rooms when not in use.
sourceNote: Summarized from the Clorox Disinfecting Wipes, Fresh Scent SDS (USA004048). The SDS has no GHS signal word; “Caution” is from the EPA label.

name: Purell Advanced Hand Sanitizer Gel

firstAid.eyes: Flush right away with plenty of water for at least 15 minutes. Remove contact lenses if easy to do. Get medical advice.
firstAid.skin: Wash with soap and water as a precaution. Get medical attention if irritation develops and continues.
firstAid.swallowed: Do NOT induce vomiting. Rinse mouth with water. Get medical attention and call Poison Control.

ppe: None normally required for hand use
Avoid contact with eyes
spill: Remove ignition sources and ventilate
The gel makes floors slippery; keep people away
Soak up with an inert absorbent and dispose of according to local rules
storage: Keep tightly closed in a dry, well-ventilated place
Keep away from heat, sparks and flame
mixing: SDS: incompatible with oxidizing agents (e.g. bleach)
house: Alcohol gel is a swallowing risk for residents with dementia. Keep refills locked up and watch wall dispensers.
sourceNote: Summarized from the PURELL Advanced Hand Sanitizer Gel SDS (400000000422). This SDS lists only CHEMTREC (1-800-424-9300) for emergencies; use Poison Control for exposures.

name: Windex Original Glass Cleaner
hazards: Not classified as hazardous on the SDS

firstAid.eyes: SDS lists no special requirements. Rinse with water if irritated.
firstAid.skin: SDS lists no special requirements. Wash off with water.
firstAid.inhaled: SDS lists no special requirements. Move to fresh air if uncomfortable.
firstAid.swallowed: SDS lists no special requirements. Call Poison Control for advice.

ppe: None required
Wash thoroughly after handling
spill: Dike large spills and clean up the residue
Empty bottle can go in the trash or recycling
storage: Keep container closed when not in use
mixing: Do not mix with bleach or any other household cleaners
sourceNote: Summarized from the Windex Original SDS (350000014153, rev. 2015). This is an older revision; check SC Johnson for the current one. The rinse/fresh-air steps are common-sense additions, not SDS text.

name: Fabuloso Multi-Purpose Cleaner, Lemon
hazards: May cause an allergic skin reaction

firstAid.eyes: Flush right away with plenty of water, holding the eye wide open and protecting the other eye. Remove contact lenses. If irritation continues, get medical attention.
firstAid.skin: Rinse well with plenty of water. Take off soaked clothing and wash it before it is worn again. If irritation or a rash develops, get medical advice.
firstAid.inhaled: Move the person away from the area. If unconscious, place in the recovery position and get medical help. If symptoms continue, call a doctor.
firstAid.swallowed: Keep the airway clear. Never give anything by mouth to an unconscious person. Call Poison Control for advice; if symptoms continue, call a doctor.

ppe: Protective gloves (it can cause an allergic skin reaction)
Tight-fitting safety goggles if it could splash; keep an eye-wash bottle of clean water nearby
Avoid breathing the mist or vapor
SDS: people with skin allergies, asthma or chronic breathing problems should not work with it
spill: Wear gloves and eye protection
Soak up with an inert absorbent (sand, sawdust or absorbent pads) and put it in a closed container
Keep the product out of drains
Do not reuse the empty bottle; dispose of according to local rules
storage: Keep the container tightly closed in a dry, well-ventilated place
mixing: Do not mix with bleach or other cleaners (general cleaning safety, not SDS text)
sourceNote: Summarized from Colgate-Palmolive's SDS for Fabuloso 2X Concentrated Lemon (SDS 660000022412, v1.0), copy hosted by Target. Colgate writes it as an industrial SDS; the bottle label covers household use. The older non-concentrated Lemon formula's SDS lists only the skin-allergy hazard. The SDS lists CHEMTREC (1-800-424-9300) for emergencies; use Poison Control for exposures. The Poison Control line under Swallowed is a common-sense addition, not SDS text.

name: Dawn Ultra Dish Soap, Original

firstAid.eyes: Rinse carefully with plenty of water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses if easy to do, then keep rinsing. Get medical attention right away if irritation continues.
firstAid.skin: Rinse with plenty of water. Get medical attention if irritation develops and continues.
firstAid.inhaled: Move to fresh air. If symptoms continue, call a doctor.
firstAid.swallowed: Rinse mouth, then drink 1 or 2 glasses of water. Do NOT induce vomiting. Get medical attention right away if symptoms occur.

ppe: None required for normal household use
Wash hands after handling
spill: Stop the leak if safe to do so
Soak up with sand, earth or another non-combustible absorbent and put it in a container
Never pour spilled product back into the bottle
Dispose of according to local rules
Spilled soap is very slippery; keep residents away until the floor is clean and dry (common sense, not SDS text)
storage: Keep the container closed when not in use
Store in a cool, dry, well-ventilated place away from heat, sparks and open flame
Keep out of reach of children
sourceNote: Summarized from P&G's SDS for Dawn Ultra Original (91931667_RET_NG, v1.01), copy hosted by Zoro. P&G provides it as a courtesy for a consumer product. This 2018 revision was the newest available online in Nov 2026; ask P&G (pgsds.im@pg.com) for the current one. The SDS lists CHEMTREC (1-800-424-9300) for emergencies; use Poison Control for exposures.

name: Ensueño Naturals Fabric Softener, Fresh Bamboo

firstAid.eyes: Hold the eye open and rinse slowly and gently with water for 15–20 minutes, until no product remains. Remove contact lenses if needed. Get medical attention if irritation develops or continues.
firstAid.skin: SDS: not a skin irritant. If it splashes, wash the area with plenty of water and soap or mild detergent until no product remains.
firstAid.inhaled: SDS: not a breathing irritant. Move to fresh air if uncomfortable.
firstAid.swallowed: Do NOT induce vomiting. Have the person drink plenty of water and get medical attention. Call Poison Control or a doctor for treatment advice.

ppe: Safety glasses and gloves (SDS rating B)
Avoid contact with eyes; wash hands after handling
spill: Small spills: wash the area with plenty of water
Large spills: wear gloves, goggles and boots; soak up with sand or sawdust and collect in closed containers
Keep heat, sparks and open flame away
Dispose of according to local rules; do not reuse empty containers
Spilled softener is slippery; keep residents away until the floor is clean and dry (common sense, not SDS text)
storage: Keep out of reach of children; keep the container closed when not in use
Store in a cool, dry, well-ventilated area away from heat, sparks or open flame
mixing: SDS: may react with strong oxidizers (e.g. bleach) and other cleaning products; do not mix
sourceNote: Summarized from AlEn's SDS for Ensueño Naturals Fresh Bamboo (FP-6050556 Rev. 1). Its next revision was due Mar 2021; ask AlEn USA for the current one. Each Ensueño scent has its own SDS and they differ (AlEn's Ensueño Baby SDS is labeled Danger), so check that your bottle says Fresh Bamboo. The SDS lists CHEMTREC (1-800-424-9300) for emergencies; use Poison Control for exposures. The fresh-air step and slippery-floor line are common-sense additions, not SDS text.
